name: card_group_same_name
description: One DECK row per card name: a plain bronze sword (loot id 128) and the curated FIRE_SWORD are both BRONZE SWORD to the player, so they share a single row (owned 3: starter 2 + loot 1, both starter copies already decked) instead of listing the same name twice. The primary (FIRE_SWORD) still supplies the row's rider icon (entry 3) and AP digit, and the DECK column reads the whole name group (2/3). Pre-grouping the DECK list showed two BRONZE SWORD rows.
